text:
maria: Hey team — AcmeCorp just opened a ticket saying they can no longer view or export audit logs after their SSO migration. They get a 403 in the UI and via API. Ticket #C-2248. Sam from the customer is in this thread.

sam (Customer: AcmeCorp): confirming — we used to download monthly CSVs for compliance. After we switched to Okta SAML last night, the 'Export' button is disabled and API calls return 403. We haven't changed roles in our IdP. Example curl we used:

```bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ACME_TOKEN\" \\
  -X GET \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/acc-9876/audit/logs/export?start=2025-12-01&end=2026-02-28\" -v

> HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
> Content-Type: application/json
{\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"reason\":\"entitlement_missing\",\"missing\":[\"audit_logs.read\"],\"retention_entitlement\":false}
```

maria: thanks, sam. Can you paste the org_id and confirm if anyone in your org can still see the audit logs? Also, did you change SCIM or group-to-role mappings in Okta?

sam (Customer: AcmeCorp): org_id is acc-9876. Only the previous org owner (before SSO) can see logs. New SSO users with Admin role cannot. We did enable SCIM but only pushed groups; not sure about custom attributes.

aj (SRE): Looks like entitlement_missing for audit_logs.read — most likely the SAML assertion or SCIM mapping didn't include the compliance entitlement. Quick repro: I reproduced with a test token missing the scope and saw the same body. Can someone paste a truncated auth header from a failing request (no token value, just header shape) and the user email on Okta? Also want the IdP metadata.

sam (Customer: AcmeCorp): sharing via secure notes: failing user is emma@acmecorp.com. Header shape: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (we're using the same API token created before SSO). Not sure if Okta replaced identities or created new ones.

aj (SRE): important detail — if token was issued to a user that got deactivated and SSO created a new federated identity, token might map to a different internal principal with fewer entitlements. Two ways to fix: 1) rebind user in SCIM or 2) grant org-level entitlement directly while we sort SSO mapping. I'll try to list the org entitlements.

```bash
# internal debugging command (redwood-internal)
redwoodctl org get-entitlements acc-9876 --json
# example output
{\n  \"org_id\": \"acc-9876\",\n  \"entitlements\": [\"basic_api\",\"embeddings.read\"]\n}
```

tess (Eng): From the logs I see the SAML assertion didn't contain the custom claim `redwood:entitlements` for the new users. Okta sometimes needs a custom SAML attribute mapping for that. If SCIM push created users but we didn't map the groups -> entitlement claim, new federated users won't get audit log perms. Quick mitigation: a workspace admin can toggle the \"Audit logs: read/export\" entitlement in Console -> Settings -> Compliance -> Audit Logs -> Access. That will restore exports immediately for all users who are org admins.

maria: sam, can you confirm if an existing owner (pre-SSO) can toggle that setting? If so, do it as a temporary fix; we'll also walk through the IdP mapping steps.

sam (Customer: AcmeCorp): owner tried and the setting is greyed out (says managed by SSO). Seems like enforcement came with SSO and console edit is blocked.

aj (SRE): that explains it — during SSO onboarding we automatically lock some entitlements to be driven by IdP (to avoid privilege creep). If the IdP doesn't provide the claim, the entitlements are dropped. We'll need to either (A) update the SCIM group mapping to include the compliance entitlement, or (B) create a short-lived bypass for this org while they update IdP.

compliance-bot: Indexing note: retention flag false for acc-9876 across 2026-01-01..2026-03-01. No export jobs queued for the period. (automated)

tess (Eng): Proposed steps to resolve:
1) Short term: create a time-limited \"org-entitlement-override\" for acc-9876 (7 days) so admins can export history and meet regulatory request. I'll prepare the change and coordinate rollout with SRE.
2) Medium term: help AcmeCorp configure their Okta SAML attribute mapping to include `redwood:entitlements` or a group claim e.g. `groups` -> mapped to `redwood:groups` which we translate to entitlements. Provide a sample SAML attribute mapping.
3) Long term: add a diagnostic page in Console that shows missing SAML attributes and recommended mappings.

aj (SRE): I'll run the override. Anyone with objections? We'll record as audit event and expire automatically.

jen (Sales): We need to tell AcmeCorp about timeline and temporary access. They have a compliance deadline next week. Please prioritize.

maria: I've updated the ticket with the planned steps and ETA. Sam, we'll create a temporary export link once the override is in place. Also, please share a small set of test SAML assertions (anonymized) so we can validate mapping.

sam (Customer: AcmeCorp): thanks — please do the override and share the link. I'll also ask our Okta admin to send the attribute mapping screenshots.

aj (SRE): action: created override (id ov-1138) for acc-9876, expires 7d from now. I triggered an on-demand export job:

```json
{\"job_id\":\"exp-20260315-001\",\"org_id\":\"acc-9876\",\"status\":\"ready\",\"download\":\"https://s3.redwood.ai/exports/exp-20260315-001.csv\"}
```

Note: link is accessible to the org owner via secure console. Export contains events up to 2026-03-14. I've added audit log entry for the override.

maria: confirmed, sam received the link privately. Next steps: (A) AcmeCorp to update Okta mapping, (B) SRE/Eng to validate a sample assertion, (C) we'll close ticket after two successful test logins showing entitlement present. Assign owner: tess.

tess (Eng): I'll draft the Okta steps here for the customer: map an attribute named `redwood:entitlements` (type `String`), value: join(groups) or add explicit values like `audit_logs.read, audit_logs.export`. Example SAML attribute in Okta UI:

- Name: `redwood:entitlements`
- Name format: Unspecified
- Value: `appuser.groups` or \"audit_logs.read,audit_logs.export\" (if static)

Also, ensure SCIM group push includes the target group used for Compliance Admins.

sam (Customer: AcmeCorp): will do. appreciate the quick turnaround and the export.

maria: closing loop: escalation -> override created -> export provided -> guidance given for permanent fix. I'll set a follow-up in 5 days to confirm IdP mapping and remove override. :white_check_mark:

jen (Sales): I'll follow up on the compliance SLA paperwork.

(compliance-bot): Reminder: override ov-1138 will auto-expire in 7 days.
